description: This file implements a GatewaySession class for managing WebSocket connections to a gateway, handling authentication, request/response messaging, event processing, and session lifecycle management, primarily used for real-time communication in an Android environment.

classes.name: GatewayClientInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a gateway client such as ID, display name, version, platform, mode, etc.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Contains options for establishing a gateway connection, including role, scopes, capabilities, commands, permissions, and client info.

classes.name: GatewayConnectErrorDetails
classes.description: Details about errors encountered during connection attempts, including error code, retry possibility, and next step recommendations.

classes.name: SelectedConnectAuth
classes.description: Represents the selected authentication method for connection, including tokens, source, and retry flags.

classes.name: GatewaySession
classes.description: Manages a websocket-based session with a gateway, handling connection lifecycle, messaging, authentication, and event processing.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates a request to invoke a command/node on the gateway.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an invocation, including success status, payload, and possible error.

classes.name: GatewaySession.ErrorShape
classes.description: Structure for conveying error information during gateway operations.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection to the gateway, managing connection setup, messaging, and closure.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates the connection process to the specified gateway endpoint with given options.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the current connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Triggers a reconnection attempt to the gateway.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to the node via the current connection.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the gateway with specified method and parameters, awaiting a response.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests a refresh of the node's canvas capability and updates the stored URL accordingly.

methods.name: connectOnce
methods.description: Performs a single attempt to connect to the gateway, establishing WebSocket connection.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrl
methods.description: Normalizes and builds the canvas host URL based on metadata, connection security, and endpoint info.
